newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK BONDS CORRECT, ECU/DRS OFF LOWS IN LATE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK BONDS CORRECT, ECU/DRS OFF LOWS IN LATE TRADE.

text.p: Ecu/drachma came off intraday lows of 302.75 to trade around 303.15/20 in late dealings and three-year coupon T-notes yielded some ground on profit-taking with depos and forex forwards holding mid-session levels, dealers said.

"Fixed coupon bonds have eased on profit taking in late dealings," said a bond dealer at a private bank. "Tax-free floaters which opened up maintain their attractiveness thanks to their tax-free status and expectations of smaller FRN spreads."
The finance ministry cut seven-, five- and three-year FRN spreads by 10 basis points to 1.30 percent, 0.80 percent and 0.30 percent respectively on Friday.
It also reduced the benchmark 12-month T-bill rate to 11.10 percent from 11.20 percent and the six-and three-month T-bill rates by 20 basis points to 10 and 10.30 percent respectively.
The two-year zero coupon note carrying a gross yield to maturity of 10.30 percent went on sale today.
The state raised about 220 billion drachmas from the open supply sale of two-year zeros to the public, a government source told Reuters.

"It looks to me that demand from retail investors was not as strong as one would have thought looking at the 220 billion drachma figure," said a trader. "A good chunk of it is commercial banks who bought the issue for souvenir."
Traders said they expected retail investors to buy heavily into the end-January T-bill issue.
The ministry will hold an auction of seven-year floaters and three-year coupon bonds on January 24 with January 28 as the settlement date and issue T-bills at the end of the month.
Money market dealers said depos were holding lower levels in longer tenors and forex forwards continued to be soft on ample liquidity.
The central bank kept its intervention overnight rate unchnaged at 12.40 percent.
The mark was quoted at 155.46/56 drachmas from Monday's 152.230 fix, the dollar at 252.43/53 drachmas from 252.230 and the Ecu at 303.06/16 from 302.980 drachmas.

"There was little action at the fixing today. Buyers showed up when ecu/drachma hit 302.75 in intraday high," said a forex trader. "It looks as if the central bank does not want ecu/drachma to drop to lower levels."
The National Bank of Greece , the domestic money market's biggest player, quoted the following late rates:
** Overnight at 11.90-12.40
** One week at 11.90-12.40
** Two weeks at 11.80-12.30
** Three weeks at 11.70-12.20
** One month at 11.60-12.10
** Two months at 11.55-12.05
** Three months at 11.40-11.90
** Six months at 11.20-11.70
** Nine months at 11.15-11.65
** Twelve months at 11.10-11.60
--Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
